/-!
# The all-left matter count and the local Lie-index checks

Cubic and linear traces. Ordinary spin with independent SU(3), no other gauged factors. We
report the conventional one-loop sign **test** using these actual trace normalizations; it is not
a calculation of a running coupling in the construction. Global anomaly theory on general
manifolds is not formalized here. The finite flat periodic *Dirac* regulator is meant to preserve
the gauge invariance exactly; the trace checks in this file alone do not establish that either.

/-- Dynkin index of all Weyl slots in the baseline inner product. -/
def leftT (F : ℕ) : ℝ := 6*F

lemma index_Weyl (F : ℕ) (X Y : su.Color) :
    - (generator F X * generator F Y).trace.re = leftT F * ⟪X,Y⟫_ℝ := by
  have ht (s : Bool) (A B : Mat) : (which s A * which s B).trace.re = (A*B).trace.re := by
    cases s
    · rfl
    rw [← which_mul, bar_trace]; rfl
  simp only [generator, ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul, Matrix.trace_blockDiagonal, re_sum, ht]
  have he := su.trace_color X Y
  let A : Mat := su.colorMat X
  let B : Mat := su.colorMat Y
  change -(∑ _ : LeftSlots F, (A*B).trace.re) = _
  change -(A*B).trace.re = (↑(2+1:ℕ):ℝ)*⟪X,Y⟫_ℝ at he
  rw [← sum_neg_distrib]; simp only [he, sum_const, card_univ, flavors, leftT]; simp; ring

/-- The sign criterion from Lie trace data, in the trace-normalization of YM.Gauge. -/
def bTrace (F : ℕ) : ℝ := (11 * su.casimir - 2 * leftT F) / 3

theorem conventional (F : ℕ) : bTrace F / 6 = 11 - 2 * F / 3 := by
  rw [bTrace,leftT,Roots.casimir]; ring

/-- Test only. -/
theorem strict_screen (F : ℕ) : 0 < bTrace F ↔ F ≤ 16 := by
  have h := conventional F
  constructor
  · intro hp
    by_contra! hF; have hq : 17 ≤ F := hF
    have he : (17:ℝ) ≤ F := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  intro hF
  have he : (F:ℝ) ≤ 16 := by exact_mod_cast hF
  linarith

theorem six_screen : bTrace 6 / 6 = 7 := by rw [conventional]; norm_num

/-! # zero-cutoff Ornamental seed and beta interpretation

Calibration of actual *free Gaussian step* with stationary gauge tree only. Masks/remainders and quantum inputs must be handled separately. -/

def betaQ (f:ℕ):ℝ:= su.slopeConstant - f*Pearl.chargeF
lemma qbeta (f:ℕ): betaQ f=(3/(4*Real.pi^2))*(11- 2*f/3):=by unfold betaQ Gauge.slopeConstant Pearl.chargeF; rw [Roots.casimir]; ring
lemma ultraviolet (f:ℕ): 0 < betaQ f ↔ f ≤ 16:=by
  rw [qbeta]; have h : 0< (3/(4*Real.pi^2)):=by positivity
  rw [mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left h]; constructor
  · intro hi; by_contra! hp; have hh:17 ≤ f:=by omega
    have he : (17:ℝ) ≤ f:= by exact_mod_cast hh
    linarith
  intro hp; have he : (f:ℝ)≤16:= by exact_mod_cast hp
  linarith
-- given a pure sum already running, shell sums in sign convention negative βα.
lemma slope_hit (F:ℕ)(h:Cumulative P E K p R u v η Ω Θ D)(hs:∀ i (p:i<N), BirthR R P (Q.station i p) (Q.engine i p) (X i) (X (i+1)) (Y i)) (A:ℕ→ℝ)
    (n i)(p:n+i ≤ N)(B:ℝ)(hh:|Tally n i A+i*(su.slopeConstant*Real.log E.L.val)|≤B): |Tally n i (fun j=> A j+F*Y j)+i*(betaQ F*Real.log E.L.val)|≤ B+F*D:=by
  have hm:= h.2 N Q X Y hs n i p
  rw [show Tally n i (fun j=> A j+F*Y j)= Tally n i A+F*Tally n i Y by unfold Tally; rw [sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]]
  unfold betaQ; rw [show (_:ℝ)+_+_*(_*Real.log E.L.val)=Tally n i A+i*(su.slopeConstant*Real.log E.L.val)+ F*(Tally n i Y - i*(Pearl.chargeF*Real.log E.L.val)) from ?_]
  · apply (abs_add_le ..).trans; rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (F:ℝ) by positivity)]; exact add_le_add hh (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (by positivity))
  ring

/-!
# Cumulative-sign instrument: log polarization of actual endpoint Dirac paths on box
of spacing 1. UNIFORM in period and in every Dirac kernel in a supported radius class.
This is one-loop geometry, NOT a lattice running-coupling theorem. Includes irrelevant
non-flat curvature vertices with arbitrary fixed prices, no positivity assumption on those
modified Dirac matrices away from flat. Normalization mixed second derivative, full (not half),
divide by volume and physical continuum plaquette k^2. Use logdet after freezing gauge, sign (-).
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

lemma wilson (P:Plan j)(C:su.Color)(h:‖C‖=1):∃ W:ℝ,∀ᶠ n:Side in atTop, |priceR C (fun X:Grid n=>bareD 0 X 0)-chargeF*Real.log n.val| ≤ W:=by
  obtain ⟨η,hη,W,H⟩:=blister P C h 0 0 -- implicit types etc
  let A: Empty→Bloom 1:= Empty.elim; let Z: Empty→Bloom 2:= Empty.elim
  have hf (m:ℕ) (A:Empty→Bloom m): Fractal A (4*η) 0 := ⟨by positivity,fun i=> i.elim, Summable.of_finite,by simp⟩
  refine ⟨W,H.mono fun n hn=>?_⟩; have he := hn Empty Empty A Z (.top j) (hf 1 A) (hf 2 Z)
  rw [show (fun X:Grid n=> bareD 0 X 0)=L₀ P (.top j) A Z n from funext fun i=>by unfold L₀; simp[rose]]; exact he
end YM.QCD.Pearl

structure Plan (j : ℕ) where
 δ : ℝ
 μ : ℝ
 good : 2≤j
 funds : 0<δ
 price : 0<μ
 below : μ<1/2
 ballad : ∀ v : Train j, ∀ p∈realCube zone, ∀ a, 2*μ ≤ (ranked v δ p a).re
lemma passport (h : 2≤j): Nonempty (Plan j):=by
  obtain ⟨δ,b,hδ,hb,H⟩:= new_law h
  let μ:= min (b/2) (1/3)
  refine ⟨⟨δ,μ,h,hδ,lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num),lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right ..) (by norm_num),fun v p hp a=>le_trans ?_ (ranking H p hp v a)⟩⟩; have he : μ ≤ b/2:=min_le_left ..; linarith
namespace Plan

-- slope.bright criterion
noncomputable def subG (N:ℕ):ℝ:= betaQ N-su.slopeConstant/2
lemma colorN (hp:N≤8):0<subG N:=by
   have h:betaQ 0=su.slopeConstant:= by simp [betaQ]
   unfold subG; rw [← h,qbeta,qbeta]
   have ht:= (show (0:ℝ)< (3/(4*Real.pi^2)) from (by positivity)); have hh: (N:ℝ) ≤8:=by exact_mod_cast hp
   nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)]
-- caller substantially.Help.
variable (χ:Chi)(hj:4 ≤ j)
include hj
set_option maxHeartbeats 750000 in
lemma canopyR (K:KernelChoices) (he:N ≤ 8) :∃ (T': Teller su), T'.bind=K∧ T'.top.supportExponent=2 ∧ T'.top.clip.direct ≤1∧∃ (Q:ConnectedActivityE6.Target su T')(s t D:ℝ) (m:ℕ),s=T'.top.width ∧t ≤ T'.top.paths∧ 0 ≤ D ∧512 ≤ m ∧ ∀ E:Patch,E.J=j → E.Branches T'.bind su→m ≤ E.L.val→2*(D+1) ≤ subG N*Real.log E.L.val ∧ Drive E T' Q F₀ χ s t D :=by
   obtain ⟨σ,η,Ω,u,v,D,γ,p,B,hσ,hη,hΩ,hu,hv,hD,hh,hγ,hX,hk,hz,hJ,hb,ht,hY,hU,hj',k,h⟩:= salutaryP K j hj
   obtain ⟨Y,Q,n,hh',h'⟩:=legible χ F₀ B hb.symm (hY ▸ hΩ) hX (ht ▸ hh) u v D γ hz hJ hγ hj' hj -- order check
   -- legible binder F₀ etc
   obtain ⟨l,hL⟩:= ranges (passportM j hj) hj hσ (zero_le_one.trans hΩ) (zero_le_one.trans hΩ)
   obtain ⟨m,hM⟩:= eventually_atTop.mp ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).const_mul_atTop (colorN he) |>.eventually_ge_atTop (2*(D+1)))
   refine ⟨B,hk,hX,(ht ▸ hh),Q,u,v,D,k+n+l+m+512,hz.symm,hJ,hD,(by omega),fun E hE hv HE=>⟨?_,?_⟩⟩ -- refine pair?

open AtlasH
open Fog.Voyage
variable {F:ℕ} (H₀: su.slopeConstant / 2 < betaQ F)

unfold height_R; linarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hv (h i)) (by positivity:(0:ℝ)≤F)]
include H₀
lemma perimeter :∀ᶠ x:ℝ in atTop,∀ (n:ℕ)(S:ℕ→SparkMesh)(P: Survey Y S n) (R:SparkMesh), Align Y R S n →∀ i≤ n,∀ p:ℝ,hub Y P x F i p → costZone Y x i p:=by
  let t:=su.slopeConstant; let r:=betaQ F; let z:=2*(r-t/2); have hz:0<z:=mul_pos (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr H₀)
  have ht:0≤ t:=(Gauge.slopeConstant_pos simple).le
  let k:ℝ:=1+F*(A+A); let d:ℝ:=3+F+Q.D; have hh:r≤t:=sub_le_self _ (mul_nonneg (by positivity:(0:ℝ)≤F) (by unfold Pearl.chargeF; positivity))
  filter_upwards [Y.freedom (2*k) (2*d) z hz, eventually_ge_atTop (0:ℝ)] with x hx hx' n S P R hp i hi v hv
  obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩:= abs_le.mp (checks Y h P R hp hi hv); have H:=hx i
  have he : d*i+k ≤ x/2+(r-t/2)*Y.measure i:=by unfold z at H; linarith only [H];
  change -(d*_+k) ≤ v-(x+r*_) at h1; change v-(x+r*_) ≤ d*_+k at h2
  unfold costZone scale; change (x+t*_)/2≤v ∧ v≤2*(x+t*_); constructor
  · linarith only [h1,he]
  linarith only [h2,he,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (Y.measure_nn i),mul_nonneg ht (Y.measure_nn i),hx']
omit H₀ in
theorem slope_all (x ε:ℝ)(he:0<ε)(F:ℕ): ∀ᶠ i:ℕ in atTop,∀ (n:ℕ)(S:ℕ→SparkMesh)(P:Survey Y S n)(R:SparkMesh)(p:ℝ), i ≤ n → Align Y R S n → hub Y P x F i p → |p/Y.measure i-betaQ F| ≤ ε:=by
   let w:=Y.measure; let b:=betaQ F; let k:ℝ:=1+F*(A+A); let d:ℝ:=3+F+Q.D
   filter_upwards [Y.outlay (k+|x|) d ε he, eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℕ)] with i hM hi n S P R p hn hp hV

import YM.QCD.Step.Gallery
import YM.RG.Block
import YM.QCD.Grass.SD
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Order

/-!
# Statement: spacings, RG scheme and densities

A scale scheme using a stiffness *window* (cf. `work/bend.tex`, "approximate kinetic
read"). The coupling is a Wilsonian coordinate, data of the scheme and trajectory,
not an intrinsically uniquely determined function of the law. Require arbitrarily fine
calibration tolerance, set before asking for a sufficiently large reference β. β enters
both in the actual gauge action at the cutoff and in the soft kernel for blocking
from each `m+1` to `m`; along with the asserted UV slope, we require it to be tracking
the **actual** (unquenched!) flat-field stiffness even at the unit of length (`m=0`),
where `β 0 = βRef` and the stiffness may differ from it by at most the prescribed tolerance.
This specifies a scheme for the physical conclusions; not specifying internal aspects of
an RG proof, like predictor jets, a normalization algorithm to select a β within a window,
or prices on polymer representations. In particular **not** claiming exact tuning
in a scheme defining the coupling by equality to a Hessian. See also README.

variable {S : Scheme} {N : ℕ} {R : Side}

/-- Unnormalized, so that support estimates for local insertions can use this
*same* denominator in every spacetime expectation. Data read only at levels `m≤N`,
precision on β along the run is imposed separately. `w m` rescales the new
(coarser) spinors in step `m+1→m`. -/
structure Run (S : Scheme) (N : ℕ) (R : Side) (F : ℕ) where
  β : ℕ → ℝ
  w : ℕ → ℝ
  u : Flavor F → ℝ
  density (m : ℕ) : Density (S.side R m) F

namespace Run
open scoped ComplexOrder
variable (A : Run S N R F)

def regulator : Regulator (S.side R N) F := ⟨A.β N,0,A.u⟩

def block (m : ℕ) := transfer (F:=F) (S.step m) S.choices (S.sides_next R m) (A.β (m+1)) (A.w m)

structure Sequence where
  S : Scheme
  N : ℕ → ℕ
  R : ℕ → Side
  A (i : ℕ) : Run S (N i) (R i) 6

namespace Stiffness

def waveNumber (n : Side) : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / n.val

def profile {n : Side} (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : Axis) (T : su.Color) (t : ℝ) : Grid n := fun X =>
  if a = X.2 then su.lieExp ((t * χ (waveNumber n * ((X.1 b).val : ℝ))) • T) else 1

def body (f : Density n F) (U : Grid n) : ℂ := Grass.coef ∅ (f U)

def action (f : Density n F) (U : Grid n) : ℝ := - Real.log (body f U).re

def read (f : Density n F) (a b : Axis) (T : su.Color) : ℝ :=
  (iteratedDeriv 2 (action f ∘ profile Real.cos a b T) 0 +
    iteratedDeriv 2 (action f ∘ profile Real.sin a b T) 0) /
      ((Fintype.card (Site n) : ℝ) * waveNumber n ^ 2)

open scoped ComplexOrder in

def betaSlope : ℝ := su.slopeConstant - 6 / (2 * Real.pi^2)

namespace Sequence
variable (C : Sequence)
/-- The block-history version of the UV slope. -/
def Slope : Prop := 0 < betaSlope ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i,
    m ≤ C.N i → |(C.A i).β m / Real.log ((C.S.spacing m)⁻¹) - betaSlope| ≤ η

/-- w near one at weak coupling; fixed-scale β bounded on every level. -/
structure Path (βRef ε : ℝ) : Prop where
  choices : C.S.choices.penalty = 1
  initialStage : 4 ≤ C.S.J 0
  infinite : Tendsto (fun i => (C.R i).val) atTop atTop
  uv : StrictMono C.N
  physical : Tendsto (fun i => C.S.spacing (C.N i)) atTop (𝓝[>] 0)
  even (i) : Even (C.R i).val
  atLeast (i) : 4 ≤ (C.R i).val
  normalized (i) : (C.A i).Actual
  separate (i) : Injective (C.A i).u
  reference (i) : (C.A i).β 0 = βRef
  compare {i m} (h : m ≤ C.N i) : Stiffness.Window ((C.A i).density m) ((C.A i).β m) ε
  beta_min {i m} (h : m ≤ C.N i) : 1 ≤ (C.A i).β m
  size (m) : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ i, m ≤ C.N i → (C.A i).β m ≤ B
  near {i m} (h : m < C.N i) : |(C.A i).w m - 1| ≤ ε
  runs : C.Slope

end Sequence
end YM.Massive

/-- Wilson regulator, t locates the negative seams as in the `Lat.Cut` convention. -/
structure Regulator (n : Side) (F : ℕ) where
  β : ℝ
  t : Site n
  m : Flavor F → ℝ

namespace Regulator
variable (R : Regulator n F)

def D (U : Grid n) : Matrix (Modes n F) (Modes n F) ℂ :=
  Matrix.blockDiagonal fun i => bareD R.t U (R.m i)

@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_D : Continuous R.D := by
  apply continuous_pi; intro i; apply continuous_pi; intro j
  rcases i with ⟨u,i⟩; rcases j with ⟨v,j⟩
  simp only [D, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]; split <;> fun_prop

/-- Joint density, no normalization. -/
def density : Insertion n F :=
  ⟨fun U => (bare R.β U : ℂ) • gauss (R.D U), by fun_prop⟩

@[simp] theorem average_one (h : R.Z ≠ 0) : R.average 1 = 1 := by
  change R.Z⁻¹ * R.Z = 1
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ h

/-- The integrated mass is real (but pointwise nonnegative gauge marginal
for a degenerate pair does not transfer by this calculation). -/
def gaugeRate (U : Grid n) : ℝ := bare R.β U * ∏ i, (bareD R.t U (R.m i)).det.re

@[simp] theorem gaugeRate_complex (U) : (R.gaugeRate U : ℂ) = ber _ (R.density U) := by
  simp only [density_apply,gaugeRate,D,map_smul,Complex.ofReal_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_prod,realD,det_amplitude,Matrix.det_blockDiagonal,smul_eq_mul]

@[fun_prop] lemma continuous_gaugeRate : Continuous R.gaugeRate := by unfold gaugeRate; fun_prop

lemma partition : R.Z = ((∫ U, R.gaugeRate U ∂prior su n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  change joint ⇑(R.density*1) = _
  rw [mul_one]; unfold joint; simp_rw [← gaugeRate_complex]; rw [integral_complex_ofReal]

lemma Z_real : R.Z = R.Z.re := by rw [R.partition, Complex.ofReal_re]

lemma ratioSpacing (hw:O.Branches K su) (m : ℕ) : ((fixed O K hw).spacing m) = ((O.L.val : ℝ)^m)⁻¹:=by unfold Massive.Scheme.spacing; rw [ratio,PNat.pow_coe,Nat.cast_pow]
lemma ratioLog (hw : O.Branches K su) (m:ℕ) : Real.log (((fixed O K hw).spacing m)⁻¹)=m*Real.log O.L.val:=by rw [ratioSpacing,_root_.inv_inv,Real.log_pow]
include hG
lemma increment (i m:ℕ) (hi:i+m≤n) : |V i - (V (i+m) - Raft.Tally i m Y)|≤2*m:=by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Raft.Tally]
  | succ m ih=>
     have h := hG.vocals (i+m) (by omega); obtain ⟨hp,he⟩:=abs_le.mp h.2.2.1
     obtain ⟨ht,hV⟩:= abs_le.mp (ih (by omega))
     apply abs_le.mpr; unfold Raft.Tally at *; rw [sum_range_succ] at *; rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith
lemma toll (hw:O.Branches T'.bind su)(m:ℕ)(hm:m≤ n): |(fly B hw V U Wv n k N).β m - run O.L x - m*(Raft.betaQ N*Real.log O.L.val)| ≤ m*(D+2)+N*W':=by
   let a:= n-m; have ht: a+m=n:=Nat.sub_add_cancel hm; have hh:=hG.finish.1; change |V a-_-_| ≤_
   obtain ⟨hx,hb⟩:= abs_le.mp (hG.receipts a m ht.le)
   obtain ⟨hc,hp⟩:= abs_le.mp (increment B b' _ A0 hG a m ht.le); rw [ht,hh] at hc hp; apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith only [hx,hb,hc,hp]
omit hG

-- one fixed accuracy ε on the slope (to avoid arbitrary-precision confusion)
variable (O : Patch)
lemma lifetime (hw:O.Branches K su)(hp: 2 ≤ O.L.val) : Tendsto (fixed O K hw|>.spacing) atTop (𝓝[>] 0):=by
   rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]; have hx : 1 < (O.L.val : ℝ):= by exact_mod_cast (show 1<O.L.val from hp)
   refine ⟨?_ ,Eventually.of_forall (fun i => ?_)⟩; swap; · rw [ratioSpacing]; change 0 < ((O.L.val:ℝ)^_)⁻¹; positivity
   simp_rw [funext (ratioSpacing hw)]; exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt hx)

lemma within (hw:O.Branches K su) (hp:2 ≤ O.L.val)(hx:0< ε)(hA:D+2 ≤ ε/2*Real.log O.L.val):∀ᶠ m:ℕ in atTop, ∀ β:ℝ, |β-run O.L x - m*(betaQ N* Real.log O.L.val)| ≤ m*(D+2)+N*W' → |β / Real.log (((fixed O K hw).spacing m)⁻¹)-betaQ N| ≤ ε:=by -- remove implicit U
    let r:= run O.L x; let a:=Real.log O.L.val; let t:= ε/2*a; have ha:0<a:= Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < O.L.val from hp)); have ht:0<t:=by unfold t; positivity
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℕ), (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R:=ℝ)).eventually_ge_atTop ((|r|+N*W')/t)] with m hm hV β h
    rw [ratioLog]; obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩:= abs_le.mp h; have ht':|r|+N*W' ≤ (m:ℝ)*t:= (div_le_iff₀ ht).mp hV; have hc : 0 < (m:ℝ)*a:=by positivity
    change |β / ((m:ℝ)*a)-betaQ N| ≤ _
    apply abs_le.mpr; unfold t at *; constructor
    · rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]; apply (le_div_iff₀ hc).mpr; unfold r a at *; linarith only [neg_le_abs (run O.L x),ht',mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) m), h1]
    rw [sub_le_iff_le_add]; apply (div_le_iff₀ hc).mpr; unfold r a at *; linarith only [le_abs_self (run O.L x),ht',mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) m), h2]
lemma SIX : Massive.betaSlope= betaQ 6 ∧ 0 < Massive.betaSlope:=by
    have he:Massive.betaSlope= betaQ 6:= by unfold Massive.betaSlope betaQ Pearl.chargeF; push_cast; ring

lemma account (hk:i≤ k)(hn:k≤ n): |registerG P.price k-registerG P.price i-Pearl.chargeF*(Y.measure k-Y.measure i)|≤ stamp J (Y.towns i)+ stamp J (Y.towns k):=by
    apply le_of_tendsto ((full Y P R hp hk hn).sub_const _ |>.abs)
    filter_upwards [price_bound Y P R i, price_bound Y P R k] with z hz hw
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq (show |P.price_R Y (R.n z) k-P.price_R Y (R.n z) i-_|=|(P.price_R Y (R.n z) k-Pearl.chargeF*(Real.log ((R.n z).val:ℝ)+Y.measure k))-(P.price_R Y (R.n z) i-Pearl.chargeF*(Real.log ((R.n z).val:ℝ)+Y.measure i))| from ?_)) ?_
    · ring_nf
    exact (abs_sub ..).trans ((add_le_add hw hz).trans_eq (add_comm ..))
omit hp in
lemma land (hk:i≤n): |registerG P.gauge i+su.slopeConstant*Y.measure i|≤ Q.D*i:=by
  induction i with
  | zero=> simp[Y.origin_cost]
  | succ i ih=>
      have h: i<n:= hk
      rw [succeeding,Y.era,mul_add]; have hh:=ih h.le
      have ht: |P.gauge i+su.slopeConstant*Real.log ((Y.length i).val:ℝ)| ≤ Q.D:=by
         have hx:= (P.steps i h).terrace.toll; simp_rw [sail,gears] at hx; linarith
      push_cast; rw [mul_add,mul_one,show registerG P.gauge i+_+(_+_)= registerG P.gauge i+su.slopeConstant* Y.measure i+(P.gauge i+su.slopeConstant* Real.log ((Y.length i).val:ℝ)) from (by ring)]
      exact (abs_add_le ..).trans (add_le_add hh ht)
omit hp in
def spin (F:ℕ)(i:ℕ):ℝ := P.gauge i+F*P.price i
lemma sum_toll (F:ℕ)(hn:i≤ n): |registerG (P.spin Y F) i+ betaQ F * Y.measure i|≤ Q.D*i+F*(stamp J (Y.towns 0)+stamp J (Y.towns i)):=by
    have he : |registerG P.price i - Pearl.chargeF*Y.measure i|≤ stamp J (Y.towns 0)+ stamp J (Y.towns i):=by simpa [Y.origin_cost] using (account Y P R hp (show 0 ≤ i from by omega) hn)

    let W:= V.steps i hl

    have h':= W.birth; let B:=(Y.beam i).fare; have H₁:= (Y.ticket i).applause; let R':= H₁.rates

Settings: d_spacetime=4 (time axis 3), SU3 in defining representation,
six (`Fin 6`) fundamental Dirac fermions. Bare stencil/mask and fermion
algebra conventions as in `QCD`, *not* `QCDVacuum`. As part of one and the same
scaling path from the normalized finite-volume theories, at a fixed inverse-square
coupling parameter `βRef` at length 1 (tolerance ε picked before asking for
it sufficiently large), need the **whole** space of primaries. We
interpret `work/claim.tex`'s existence goal with allowance for changes
in RG/estimate schemes, not asking to verify every claim of the proposed proof.
Include explicit PCAC and flavor systems along with Stress uniqueness &
orientation test and local charge action of that stress. Reflection positivity
and the real-time conclusion both required.

Spacetime-limit order: one sequence of cutoffs and physical periods, with
point moments and arbitrary joints. Require achieving that scaling limit
with an ensemble of phases; full fields and Ward relations don't change in vacuum
selection. Color charged fields are NOT requested. Particle masses, spectral gap
and confinement are not requested.
-/

/-- Conditions of the existence claim. -/
def TheoryAt (βRef ε : ℝ) : Prop := ∃ (C : Sequence) (P : Calibration C) (F : Fields)
    (m : MassFields) (s : Signals) (B : Bases F) (T : Momentum F) (S : Fields.Kernel F) (V : Vacua F),
  0 < βRef ∧
  Geometry ∧
  C.Path βRef ε ∧
  P.System ∧
  s.Read C ∧
  F.System P ∧
  Fields.Scaling S C P ∧
  Fields.Euclidean S ∧
  s.PCAC F m ∧
  s.Masses ∧
  Physics.Stress F T ∧
  Physics.Ward T S ∧
  B.Content P T ∧
  B.Comparison S ∧
  (∃ w : Continuation F, w.Produces S) ∧
  V.Decomposes S T B

def Goal : Prop := ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ β in atTop, TheoryAt β ε
